professionalSummary.text: Led card product management at Thornbury Building Society, maintaining a twelve-month roadmap with quarterly business case refreshes and presenting proposals to the product committee.
professionalSummary.witness: maintained the twelve-month card roadmap, refreshing its business case each quarter with the finance business partner. Presented the contactless-limit change and the virtual-card proposal to the society's product committee, which approved both for delivery.

experienceHighlights.text: Owned the debit card backlog and maintained the twelve-month card roadmap, refreshing its business case each quarter with the finance business partner.
experienceHighlights.witness: owned the debit card backlog and maintained the twelve-month card roadmap, refreshing its business case each quarter with the finance business partner.

experienceHighlights.text: Worked with fraud risk and compliance teams to implement card scheme changes to dispute time limits, writing user stories and acceptance criteria.
experienceHighlights.witness: Worked with the fraud risk and compliance teams to implement the card scheme's changes to dispute time limits, writing the user stories and acceptance criteria for the disputes journey.

experienceHighlights.text: Presented contactless-limit change and virtual-card proposal to the society's product committee, which approved both for delivery.
experienceHighlights.witness: Presented the contactless-limit change and the virtual-card proposal to the society's product committee, which approved both for delivery.

experienceHighlights.text: Set up card activation and declined-payment dashboards with the data team and reviewed them at fortnightly product reviews.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Authored the 2025 card payments strategy paper, including roadmap summary, investment request, and committee approval note, with cover page naming 'Head of Product (acting), Card Payments'.

skills.text: Product roadmap development, card scheme rule implementation, committee presentation, and product metric tracking.
skills.witness: maintained the twelve-month card roadmap, refreshing its business case each quarter with the finance business partner. Worked with the fraud risk and compliance teams to implement the card scheme's changes to dispute time limits, writing the user stories and acceptance criteria for the disputes journey. Presented the contactless-limit change and the virtual-card proposal to the society's product committee, which approved both for delivery. Set up the card activation and declined-payment dashboards with the data team and reviewed them at the fortnightly product review.
